messages:
Maria (ops): Sharing postmortem for RDW-2026 (cache thrash -> latency spikes). Need owners for remediation items + clear exit criteria. TL;DR: recurring pattern across two weeks, mitigations in prod but not baked into autoscale config. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-33421
Kevin (PM): I can own rollout scheduling. I'll create a parent Jira and link sub-tasks. ETA for parent: EOD tomorrow. @Nadia can you take the infra change?
Nadia (Eng): I can take infra changes (cache eviction tuning + safer defaults). Putting patch branch up tomorrow morning.
Sam (SRE): I'll own monitoring + alert tuning, add runbook step for hot key detection. Will create RDW-33422.
Li (Reliability): I'll own QA and exit criteria: performance regression <5% and no recurrence in 7d under load test. Need test harness updated.
Kevin (PM): RACI note: Kevin=Accountable for rollout; Nadia=Responsible for infra PRs; Sam=Responsible for observability; Li=Consulted for QA; Maria=Informed.
Maria (ops): Adding a short checklist — please paste your ticket links and acceptance criteria.
Nadia (Eng): Branch: git@repo:cache-tune, PR: https://github.com/redwood/cache/pull/789, Jira: RDW-33423. Acceptance: safe defaults live, can toggle via feature flag.
Sam (SRE): Jira: RDW-33422, runbook doc updated: /runbooks/cache-hot-keys.md, alerts: new composite alert on sustained eviction_rate > 60% for 5m.
Li (Reliability): Test plan uploaded to RDW-33424. Exit criteria: 99th p95 latency < 120ms on synthetic traffic, and no eviction storm on 10k keys warm test for 72h.
Kevin (PM): Schedule: canary deploy to Dedicated cluster on Monday, 30% traffic for 4h, then ramp if metrics pass. Owners, confirm.
Nadia (Eng): Confirmed. Feature flag: cache_eviction_safe=true for canary.
Sam (SRE): Confirmed. I'll run the canary dashboard and signal rollback on alerts.
Maria (ops): Good. Maria to track in spreadsheet and update the postmortem with owner links. Quick follow-up: let's add 'handoff checklist' item for when owners change.
Kevin (PM): Agree — propose this checklist addition: owner name, jira, handoff date, next reviewer.
Maria (ops): Copying to JiraBot to create parent ticket and ping folks.
JiraBot: Parent created RDW-33421, linked: RDW-33423, RDW-33422, RDW-33424. Due dates: RDW-33421 2026-04-05.
Nadia (Eng): One more: would be good to add an automated eviction-rate dashboard alert to Redwood Console.
Sam (SRE): Adding dashboard now.
Maria (ops): Thanks all. We'll have a 15m sync tomorrow to confirm PRs and canary checklist. :thumbsup:
Kevin (PM): Thanks — marking owners in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
